origin: Racing Bulls began life in the dusty workshops of Faenza, Italy, born from the shared passion of three childhood friends: Marco Bellini, a talented engineer; Sofia Rossi, a resourceful strategist; and Giovanni Esposito, a fearless driver. They started small, pooling their savings and scavenging parts from junkyards to build their first car, a battered but surprisingly quick machine christened 'Il Toro Scatenato' (The Raging Bull). Their early races were a comedy of errors and near-misses, but their raw enthusiasm and relentless spirit quickly won them a local following. They were the quintessential underdog, always punching above their weight. A pivotal moment came at the 2018 Imola Regional Championship race where Esposito, against all odds, secured a podium finish, proving that Racing Bulls was a force to be reckoned with, even on a shoestring budget.
philosophy: Racing Bulls operates on a simple, yet effective philosophy: passion over precision. They prioritize ingenuity and adaptability over expensive, cutting-edge technology. Their car development is driven by driver feedback and on-the-fly adjustments, fostering a tight-knit team culture where everyone has a voice. They believe in taking risks, learning from mistakes, and above all, having fun – a mantra that often translates to unexpected victories and memorable moments on the track.
achievements: 2021 Italian National Series - Top 10 Finish (Team Championship)
Multiple class wins in local hill climb events

teamPrincipal.name: Sofia Rossi
teamPrincipal.background: Sofia is the strategic brain behind Racing Bulls. With a background in business management and a keen eye for detail, she keeps the team grounded and focused, expertly managing their limited resources. She's known for her calm demeanor and ability to make tough decisions under pressure.

keyFigures.name: Marco Bellini
keyFigures.description: Marco is the engineering wizard who brings the cars to life. He has a knack for finding innovative solutions with limited resources and is constantly tinkering with the cars to squeeze out every last bit of performance.

keyFigures.name: Giovanni Esposito
keyFigures.description: Giovanni is the heart and soul of Racing Bulls. His aggressive driving style and unwavering determination inspire the team to push their limits. He's a natural talent with a hunger for success.

headquarters: Racing Bulls is based in a modest workshop on the outskirts of Faenza. The facility is basic, but functional, equipped with essential tools and a passionate team working tirelessly to improve their cars. It's a place where ingenuity thrives, and the scent of oil and ambition hangs heavy in the air.
fanBase: Racing Bulls boasts a dedicated local following, drawn to their underdog spirit and exciting racing style. They are seen as the 'people's team', a symbol of passion and determination in a world of corporate giants. Their fans are fiercely loyal, often sporting homemade Racing Bulls merchandise and cheering them on at every race.
